concerns.text: FR-001 requires downloading the global NOAA NCEP/NCAR daily surface pressure dataset. The task list only implements a download of a *verified test* pressure dataset and logs DEV‑001 when the global source is missing, leaving the mandatory global download unimplemented and thus weakening the functional requirement.

FR-002 mandates interpolation of the coarse pressure fields to a fine‑resolution grid before anomaly calculation. No task in the list performs this interpolation step; the pipeline proceeds directly from raw test data to preprocessing, constituting a semantic weakening of the requirement.

FR-011 requires stratification of control windows by ENSO/PDO climate indices. The tasks instead use a proxy control‑window strategy flagged with `PROXY_NOT_FULFILLING_FR011` and reference DEV‑002, which is a documented deviation but still represents a weakening of the mandatory requirement.
